title: Market Analysis for the Week of 10/25
ref_note: ES list has 7733-7735 (monitor for LAAF) but the Trading Higher text writes 7731-7735; wes4/wes5/wes7 and the ES caution keep 7731-7735 as written. NQ text writes 29200-29226 for the daily level (external: Monday's daily plan used 29194-29220). 'this past week's low' on ES has no number in the letter. NQ 870-960 resolved to 29870-29960 (supply around 903-932). 'September's low' in the pause-on-shorts caution read as the ETH low 28816.25 he names just before (RTH low is 28878.75). Not made trades (borderline): ES possible failed reclaim at a daily ~7658; ES look above and fail of Thursday's high (no number) in the 7742.5-7751 gap; ES move back to the ATH above 7815-7820 ('we'll respect range high until proven otherwise'); NQ swing low off the 8/3 open/low 28419/28313.3; 'Any fresh loss of 623-656 must produce a loss of at least 380-436' (a requirement, not a trade).

ES.quote: High of week was 7812.25 on ES and 30113 on NQ.

ES.label: Thursday afternoon rally high
ES.quote: Thursday’s afternoon rally high stopped at 7724.5.

ES.label: bearish RTH gap · reactive on first test
ES.quote: We do have a bearish RTH gap 7742.5-7751. I would almost always use a bearish RTH gap as a weekly level but chose not to. It is likely to be reactive on first test and could possibly produce a look above and fail of Thursday’s high, but I’m not convinced it would be a durable weekly level.

ES.quote: Last week we had strong supply in the 7780-7784 up to 7815-7820 range and this past week dropped some fresh (not as strong) supply once again.

NQ.quote: A fresh fail/LAAF of 29269-29303 most likely resolves to 29069-29038 and this past week’s 28987 low, mindful of the 29200-29226 range or so which will be a daily level for Monday.

NQ.label: September RTH low
NQ.quote: The 28878.75 September RTH low and 28816.25 September ETH low remain an obvious target below price, but until I see a clear change from sellers, I’ll remain wary of initiating any short near 29038-29069 and 28944-28969.

trades.name: LBAF of this past week's low / 7644-7649
trades.quote: A LBAF of this past week’s low in the 7644-7649 range can rotate back to 7676-7681.

trades.name: reclaim of 7676-7681 after a LBAF
trades.quote: If 7676-7681 is reclaimed after a LBAF, then the trading higher scenario comes into play.

trades.name: continuation below 7644-7649 (box breakdown)
trades.quote: With continuation below this past week’s low and the 7644-7649 range we have confirmation of the multi-day box breakdown (the Friday mother bar box) and entry into the white box (the two pictures above). This is objectively a continuation short. The major target is 7569-7575 and then 7541-7543 (monitor for continuation from there).

trades.name: firm base above 7769-7772

trades.name: 903-932 strong enough → fresh loss of 623-656

trades.quote: I still would be extremely cautious on the long side and am likely to look for shorts if 30210-30237 trades. I would reiterate that this level is likely to be traded through if seen, but I will start looking for fresh short setups.
